annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it actively promotes paid cryptocurrency packages while presenting recruitment-based commissions, multi-level team bonuses, and extraordinary account-growth claims as reasons to participate. It describes a binary compensation structure with earnings from weaker-side business volume and multiple generations, while also promising that purchased tokens can increase dramatically in value. The presentation and signup link encourage viewers to join rather than investigate or criticize the offer.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the promoted earnings depend on building teams, weaker-side business volume, and bonuses paid across multiple generations; S05 is separately supported because paid token packages are promoted with appreciation and holding-return claims.
